'''''The Travels of Jain Farstrider''''' is a famous book written by [[Jain Farstrider]]. Published in the year {{ne|968}},{{ref/book|3|Glossary}} it consists largely of his travels across the world, including stories of the highly mysterious land of [[Shara]] beyond the [[Aiel Waste]],{{ref/book|6|17}} encounters with the [[Sea Folk]], and numerous fantastic adventures. The popular book appears in libraries across the [[Westlands]], from an [[Queen's Blessing|inn]] in [[Caemlyn]]{{ref/book|1|36}} to small personal libraries on remote farms.{{ref/book|1|5}}
